articles.title: Maple Leafs at Golden Knights projected lineups
NHL EDGE stats: McKenna sets fastest skating speed by 18-year-old
Leafs drop 4-3 shootout decision in Vegas

away.summary: The Maple Leafs are 2-2-1 after a shootout loss to Vegas, seeking their first back-to-back wins of the season. They project to start Anthony Stolarz in net with Dakota Joshua (core) and Max Domi (undisclosed) injured. Gavin McKenna continues to impress as an 18-year-old rookie, setting NHL EDGE skating speed records.

returning: Scott Wedgewood (expected first start of season)
home.summary: The Avalanche (2-1-0) are playing the second game of a back-to-back after a 3-2 loss to Winnipeg. They project Scott Wedgewood to start in net over Mackenzie Blackwood, with Logan O'Connor (lower body) injured. Colorado has a strong .720 points percentage in second games of back-to-backs since 2020-21.
